title: Grilled Kenyan Skewers with Smoky BBQ Sauce
description: A flavorful and aromatic skewer dish inspired by Kenyan cuisine, with a smoky BBQ sauce to add a sweet and tangy twist.
instructions: Thread beef strips, onion, bell pepper, and tomato onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika and olive oil.
Brush skewers with the paprika mixture, then season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While skewers are cooking, heat smoky BBQ sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once skewers are done, brush with smoky BBQ sauce and serve immediately.
